<script id="bvb-preview-engine">window.BVBInitPreviewEngine=function(){
 'use strict';
 let paused=false,speed=1,targetMode='moving',lanes=[],selected=0;
 const actualStep=step,actualSpecial=specialAbility;

 function reset(tier,canvas){
   MU.s=MU.m=1;try{if(AC)AC.suspend();}catch(_){}
   S.tr||={};S.tr[selected]=tier;S.own=[selected];

   dummy.abilityCd=Infinity;dummy.baseDmg=0;dummy.x=180;dummy.y=100;
   dummy.vx=targetMode==='moving'?.64:0;dummy.vy=targetMode==='moving'?.37:0;
   dummy.hp=dummy.mh=100000;dummy.trail=[];
   // Test setup has no arena obstacles obscuring the target.
   G.obs=[];G.obstacles=[];
   const lane={g:G,tier,canvas,accumulator:0,damage:0,anchor:{x:180,y:100}};
   return lane;
 }
 function start(id,canvases){selected=id;lanes=canvases.map((c,i)=>reset(i+1,c));}
 function setTarget(mode){targetMode=mode==='fixed'?'fixed':'moving';for(const lane of lanes){const d=lane.g.bl.find(o=>o.previewDummy);if(!d)continue;lane.anchor={x:d.x,y:d.y};d.vx=targetMode==='moving'?.64:0;d.vy=targetMode==='moving'?.37:0;}}
 function drawDummy(ctx,o){
   const r=o.r||17;ctx.save();ctx.translate(o.x,o.y);ctx.shadowBlur=0;
   ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.strokeStyle='#000';ctx.lineWidth=r*.085;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
   ctx.fillStyle='#ff1828';for(const x of [-.35,.35]){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x*r,-.39*r,.175*r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
   ctx.strokeStyle='#ff1828';ctx.lineWidth=r*.095;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-r*.43,r*.19);ctx.lineTo(r*.42,r*.22);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.strokeStyle='#000';ctx.lineWidth=r*.015;for(const x of [-.43,.42]){ctx.fillRect(x*r-r*.04,r*.16,r*.08,r*.08);ctx.strokeRect(x*r-r*.04,r*.16,r*.08,r*.08);}
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function advance(dt){
   for(let i=0;i<lanes.length;i++){
     let lane=lanes[i];G=lane.g;S.tr[selected]=lane.tier;
     if(!paused&&(G.ph!=='battle'||G.rt>18)){lane=lanes[i]=reset(lane.tier,lane.canvas);G=lane.g;}
     if(!paused){lane.accumulator+=Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,dt))*speed;
       while(lane.accumulator>=1/60){

         actualStep(1/60);lane.accumulator-=1/60;
         if(d){lane.damage+=Math.max(0,d.mh-d.hp);d.hp=d.mh;if(targetMode==='fixed'){d.x=lane.anchor.x;d.y=lane.anchor.y;d.vx=d.vy=0;}d.trail=[];}
         if(!G||G.ph!=='battle')break;
       }
     }
     cv=lane.canvas;cx=cv.getContext('2d');draw();
   }
 }

   description:(id,tier)=>{S.tr[id]=tier;const st=getBallStats(id);return st.evolutionDesc||st.activeDesc||B[id].d;},inspect:()=>lanes.map(l=>({tier:l.tier,time:l.g.rt,damage:l.damage,dummy:l.g.bl.find(o=>o.previewDummy),actor:l.g.bl.find(o=>!o.previewDummy),game:l.g}))};
};

 document.head.append(style);
 function portrait(id,tier=1){
  if(window.BVBAppearance?.ids.includes(id))return window.BVBAppearance.portrait(id,tier);
  if(id>=39&&id<=51)return window.BVB3951Visual.imgFor(id,tier);
  const approved=window.BVBBatch01Art?.imageForTier(id,tier);if(approved)return approved.src;
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(art(id));
 }
 function childSource(){
   // Each preview runs the unmodified combat engine with an in-memory save.
   // The real game's progress, random state and current match stay in the parent.
   // Remove runtime UI through the DOM. A text regex can also match its own
   // source inside this script, truncating the script before the child bridge.
   const root=document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
   for(const node of root.querySelectorAll('#bvbSkillBrowser, .simulation-frame, script[src*=supabase], script[src*=bvb-accounts]'))node.remove();
   let source='<!doctype html>'+root.outerHTML;
   source=source.replaceAll('localStorage','BVBPreviewStorage');
   source=source.replace('D = 2;', 'D = 4/3;');
   source=source.replaceAll('Math.floor(time*30)','Math.floor(time*60)');
   source=source.replace('if (o.b?.id>=16 && o.b?.id<=25 && window.BVB1625Visual)', 'if(o.previewDummy){window.BVBPreviewBridge.drawDummy(cx,o,renderG);} else if (o.b?.id>=16 && o.b?.id<=25 && window.BVB1625Visual)');
   const state={...S,ms:1,mm:1};
   const boot=`<script>window.BVB_PREVIEW_CHILD=true;window.requestAnimationFrame=()=>0;window.cancelAnimationFrame=()=>{};const BVBPreviewStorage={getItem:k=>k==='bvb_hw_120_v3'?${JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(state)).replaceAll('<','\\u003c')}:null,setItem(){},removeItem(){},clear(){}};<\/script>`;
   return source.replace(/<head[^>]*>/i,m=>m+boot);
 }
 function dispose(){generation++;for(const frame of frames)frame.remove();frames=[];}
 function create(){if(modal)return;
   modal=document.createElement('div');modal.id='bvbSkillBrowser';modal.hidden=true;modal.setAttribute('role','dialog');modal.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');modal.setAttribute('aria-label','Podgląd umiejętności');
   modal.innerHTML=`<div class="shell"><header><div><small>BALL VS BALL 2.0</small><h1>Podgląd umiejętności</h1></div><button data-close>Zamknij ✕</button></header><nav class="paging" aria-label="Strony kulek"><button data-prev>← Poprzednia</button><span data-page></span><button data-next>Następna →</button><select data-pages aria-label="Wybierz stronę">${pages.map((p,i)=>`<option value="${i}">Strona ${i+1} · ID ${p[0]}–${p.at(-1)}</option>`).join('')}</select></nav><div class="catalog" role="group" aria-label="Wybierz kulkę"></div><h2 data-name></h2><div class="tools"><button data-pause>Pauza</button><button data-replay>Od początku ↻</button><label>Prędkość <select data-speed><option value="0.5">0,5×</option><option value="1" selected>1×</option><option value="2">2×</option></select></label><label>Cel <select data-target><option value="moving">Ruchomy</option><option value="fixed">Stały</option></select></label><span data-fps class="status">— FPS</span><span class="status" role="status">Ładowanie…</span></div><div class="columns">${[1,2,3].map(v=>`<article><div class="stage">V${v}</div><canvas width="480" height="480" aria-label="Podgląd V${v}"></canvas><p class="desc"></p></article>`).join('')}</div><p class="status">Test umiejętności na kulce testowej • ten sam silnik, grafiki, trafienia i efekty co w grze. Postęp w podglądzie nie jest zapisywany.</p></div>`;
   modal.querySelector('[data-close]').onclick=close;
   modal.querySelector('[data-prev]').onclick=()=>setPage(page-1);
   modal.querySelector('[data-next]').onclick=()=>setPage(page+1);
   modal.querySelector('[data-pages]').onchange=e=>setPage(+e.target.value);
   modal.querySelector('[data-replay]').onclick=()=>choose(selected);
   modal.querySelector('[data-pause]').onclick=()=>{paused=!paused;for(const f of frames)f.contentWindow.BVBPreviewBridge?.pause(paused);modal.querySelector('[data-pause]').textContent=paused?'Wznów':'Pauza';};
   modal.querySelector('[data-speed]').onchange=e=>{speed=+e.target.value;for(const f of frames)f.contentWindow.BVBPreviewBridge?.speed(speed);};
   modal.querySelector('[data-target]').onchange=e=>{targetMode=e.target.value;frames[0]?.contentWindow.BVBPreviewBridge?.setTarget(targetMode);};
   modal.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')close();if(e.key==='Tab'){const focusable=[...modal.querySelectorAll('button,select')].filter(el=>!el.disabled);const first=focusable[0],last=focusable.at(-1);if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}}};
   canvases=[...modal.querySelectorAll('canvas')];document.body.append(modal);
 }
 function setPage(value,initial){page=Math.max(0,Math.min(pages.length-1,value));const catalog=modal.querySelector('.catalog');catalog.replaceChildren();
   modal.querySelector('[data-page]').textContent=`Strona ${page+1} / ${pages.length} · ID ${pages[page][0]}–${pages[page].at(-1)}`;
   modal.querySelector('[data-pages]').value=page;modal.querySelector('[data-prev]').disabled=page===0;modal.querySelector('[data-next]').disabled=page===pages.length-1;
   for(const id of pages[page]){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='choice';b.dataset.id=id;b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=portrait(id,1);img.alt='';const label=document.createElement('span');label.textContent='#'+id+' '+B[id].n;b.append(img,label);b.onclick=()=>choose(id);catalog.append(b);}choose(initial??pages[page][0]);
 }
 function activate(bridge){
   bridge.setTarget(targetMode);bridge.start(selected,canvases);bridge.speed(speed);bridge.pause(paused);
   for(let tier=1;tier<=3;tier++)modal.querySelectorAll('.desc')[tier-1].textContent=bridge.description(selected,tier);
   modal.querySelector('.tools [role=status]').textContent='V1 · V2 · V3 — kulka testowa';lastTime=0;
 }
 function choose(id){selected=id;paused=false;modal.querySelector('[data-pause]').textContent='Pauza';modal.querySelector('[data-name]').textContent='#'+id+' · '+B[id].n;
   for(const b of modal.querySelectorAll('.choice'))b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(+b.dataset.id===id));
   for(const c of canvases)c.getContext('2d').clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
   const existing=frames[0]?.contentWindow.BVBPreviewBridge;
   if(existing){activate(existing);return;}
   if(frames.length)return;
   modal.querySelector('.tools [role=status]').textContent='Ładowanie wspólnego silnika…';
   const token=generation,iframe=document.createElement('iframe');iframe.className='simulation-frame';iframe.title='Silnik testów umiejętności';iframe.tabIndex=-1;iframe.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
   iframe.onload=async()=>{if(token!==generation)return;try{
     const w=iframe.contentWindow;await w.BVBAppearance?.ready;await w.BVBParty65?.ready;await w.BVBParty87?.ready;await w.BVBLastLive?.ready;if(token!==generation)return;
     if(!w.BVBPreviewBridge)throw Error('Brak silnika podglądu');activate(w.BVBPreviewBridge);
   }catch(e){modal.querySelector('.tools [role=status]').textContent='Nie udało się uruchomić podglądu: '+e.message;}};
   frames.push(iframe);sourceCache||=childSource();iframe.srcdoc=sourceCache;modal.append(iframe);
 }
 function tick(now){if(!modal||modal.hidden){animation=0;return;}
   const dt=lastTime?Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,(now-lastTime)/1000)):0;lastTime=now;
   const bridge=frames[0]?.contentWindow.BVBPreviewBridge;
   if(!document.hidden){try{bridge?.advance(dt);}catch(e){modal.querySelector('.tools [role=status]').textContent='Błąd podglądu: '+e.message;}}
   fpsFrames++;if(now-fpsTime>=1000){modal.querySelector('[data-fps]').textContent=Math.round(fpsFrames*1000/(now-fpsTime))+' FPS';fpsFrames=0;fpsTime=now;}
   animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 function open(id=0){create();previousFocus=document.activeElement;modal.hidden=false;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';page=Math.max(0,pages.findIndex(p=>p.includes(id)));setPage(page,id);modal.querySelector('[data-close]').focus();if(!animation)animation=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
 function close(){if(!modal)return;modal.hidden=true;dispose();sourceCache=null;lastTime=0;if(animation)cancelAnimationFrame(animation);animation=0;document.body.style.overflow='';previousFocus?.focus();}
 const entry=document.createElement('button');entry.className='b ac';entry.type='button';entry.textContent='🎬 Podgląd umiejętności';entry.onclick=()=>open(0);entry.style.cssText='width:100%;margin:10px 0';document.querySelector('#menu')?.append(entry);
 window.BVBSkillBrowser=Object.freeze({open,close,pages});
 if(window.BVB3951Visual)window.BVB3951Visual.openPreview=id=>open(id??39);
})();
